bullets: Built a modular PyTorch package — CLI train/eval/visualize entry points, seeded reproducible configs, Weights & Biases tracking — for neural-implicit surrogate models of 3D physical fields in metal additive manufacturing, trained on a 464-geometry simulation dataset (~39 timesteps × 8,192-point clouds).

Found and fixed a silent data-pipeline defect (stale cached coordinates against a per-frame-resampled point cloud) that had been driving R² to −1.1 with no error signal, then corrected the masked-loss evaluation protocol; reached R² ≈ 0.83 on in-horizon field reconstruction.
Isolated the remaining failure mode to latent-code drift (‖z_pred‖/‖z_gt‖ ≈ 2.3) through controlled single-variable experiments, separating an extrapolation problem from a capacity problem.

Extended the study across temperature, displacement, and stress fields, roughly halving validation error and identifying a hyperparameter setting consistent across all three; integrated results into the lab's benchmarking framework against Transolver, FNO, and GNOT.
